content:
Small warning: this message might make people worried about Covid more anxious, but I want to be honest about what's going on so here it is :/

I really wanted to be online today but I've been kind of shot with a big dose of reality and I think I'm going to need some time offline. My health has been kind of off lately and this morning I finally had a virtual appointment with my doctor. I thought worse case scenario I'd maybe have to come in and get some blood work done or something but instead she referred me to get tested for Covid-19, which I just got back from doing. My symptoms are in no way serious, so even if this is Covid I consider myself very lucky. I don't even have a fever or cough, which is why I was so caught off guard by being asked to get tested. The test results should come back within 24-48 hours so I suppose I'll know for sure soon. I'm going to be really surprised if it's covid since I've been doing everything you're supposed to do in a pandemic (stay home, wear a mask), but I guess if any of you haven't been doing that then... Pls do it. 
I might still be checking in to read the story from time to time but I don't think I'll be up for any rp until I have a better handle on what's going on. My room is already set up for me to basically live in it in case college gets cancelled so self isolating shouldn't be too bad. I even have my own coffee machine :)
I know my character has been a bit important right now with stuff like Zone of Truth and I wish she could be there for the story, but I think you guys know my character pretty well by now so just do me a favor and imagine what she'd do. Game wise she can just spend all her time in the library reading 😌

@everyone 
Rule one. 
Happiness is mandatory. Anyone not happy with their experience must be killed immediately so that a new, better, happier version of you may be given the chance to experience duckton.

Rule two. 
It isn’t fun to talk about the rules. And anyone caught not having fun is evidently unhappy. And as we all know: Happiness is mandatory.

Rule three.
All hygienic standards must be followed at all times including proper care of the duck uniform. Anyone not wearing a perfectly clean and undamaged duck uniform is in violation, and cannot prove that they are a duck. And as well all know: Ducks are the happiest animal on earth.

Rule four. 
Duckton is a capitalist enterprise. Evil goose communists and ganderistic activities must be reported immediately. Anyone not enjoying capitalism is clearly not having fun. And as we all know: sharing is not as fun as winning. 

Rule five
Friend Beholder will always tell the truth, is always fair and always good.
